WORK id=tsp_iv4_three_body_d8 kind=hubo beta=1.0000000000000000 n=8 q=2 warmup=400 draws=2000 thin=1 trials=5 seed0=260801915
SOURCE arXiv:2608.01615 §IV.4 and Appendix J.3, reduced from d=12 to d=8 so a histogram of a few thousand draws can be compared with the exact law. 12 pairs, 10 triples, weights i.i.d. N(0, 0.6^2). The paper does not publish the draw seed; this pin uses ferrotherm::rng::Pcg::new(260801615, 0x54535031), Box-Muller, and rejection-sampled Fisher-Yates. Native chromatic Gibbs of the three-body energy, not Figure 12.
